review: Independent parallel C/F review found real defect: initial implementation reused SQL-only owned_process_snapshot for AuthServer/DbServer; actual service snapshots would always refuse. Old fully mocked orchestration tests hid it.

Fix separates service snapshots: exact expected normalized AuthServer/DbServer image path and name, positive start ticks, PID, original Popen liveness before/after, unchanged binary SHA and matching initial/final generation. Existing SQL-only observer remains unchanged and SQL generation is compared separately.
Real-shaped snapshot JSON tests refuse wrong service/path/PID/bool ticks/process reuse/binary mutation/exit. Orchestration SQL mock now rejects every servicePID. Six independent host methods pass.

Fresh hosted nonce LocalDB/database, exact accepted full schema/templates and retained Db/Auth binaries, inactive-before-Db to active-after-original-source transition, two exact owned reciprocal loopback endpoints and game listener proof form a coherent bounded experiment.
Owned reverse-order Job Object cleanup precedes firewall removal and LocalDB teardown. Requested stream-close error handling now continues all subsequent cleanup and failed cleanup refuses passed.

Firewall rules are explicitly scoped to original IPv4 surfaces/nonloopbackIPv4, rather than claiming universal IPv6 isolation. No client account login/probe repeats, checksum reference alias, version override or MapServer is introduced.

Host schema recovery/source mocks are not actual LocalDB/service/network qualification. Fresh Windows run must preserve exact schema/binary/source identity and cleanup receipts before claiming original interserver activation.
